ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by a dominant central low-intensity (black/dark brown) region (approx. 35% area) against peripheral high-intensity (white/cream) lobe surfaces (approx. 65% area).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central black pigmentation originates from the insertion point, extending outward along the interior trailing edges. Lobes feature high-intensity white backgrounds with significant brownish-yellow amorphous mottling localized in the central-lateral regions of both lobes. Distinct high-contrast dark linear streaks and a rectangular spot are mapped on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 50-60 degrees at the central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant peak-to-valley pixel amplitude observed, with approximately 12-15 distinct primary serration points on each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to upwardly hooked distal tips; leading edge exhibits a smooth convex trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Massive high-intensity (white/tan) calcified clusters localized on the distal tip of the right lobe. Smaller, lower-density clusters visible on the distal tip of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct dark, near-vertical linear marks on the right lobe's high-intensity surface; faint diagonal brownish-tinted scratches visible on the left lobe's interior surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both distal tips, specifically concentrated on the right fluke tip. Pervasive brownish-yellow discoloration across the primary high-intensity regions of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: One sharp, dark rectangular pigmentation mark located on the upper interior quadrant of the right lobe near the trailing edge.
